title: Zeus' Modded Mess
description: A mod pack originally created for my friends and I, but is free for anyone to enjoy!
body:
Zeus' Modded Pack contains many content-adding mods. I was trying to recreate the feel of modded packs from older versions. In total there are 200+ biomes (check mod list for more details), which means more wood types, more animals, and different items to craft. You will also find new ores, decorative blocks, the create mod (I know you all love it), and many QOL mods.

The modpack is still a work in progress, so do expect a small bug here and there. If I find any issues I will fix them ASAP, however, I am not hosting an issue tracker or any similar method of reporting issues. The modpack was tested on multiple specs (good PC, bad PC, Windows, MacOS), and performed well with changes in the Minecraft settings (render distance, quality, etc.)

Generally, I made this modpack for my friends and I, but I'm sure others would love to try it out. You can remove the client-only mods and host the modpack on a server if you'd like! I plan on uploading server versions as soon as I have the time.

Have fun!
